label: H.R. 6143

selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: The PRECISE Act amends various USDA agricultural programs to support the adoption of precision agriculture practices and technologies. It defines precision agriculture in federal law, updates loan and conservation programs to include precision farming activities, offers increased payment rates for certain conservation practices related to precision agriculture, and emphasizes third-party technical assistance for soil health planning.

affected_groups.effect: Gain access to expanded loan options, higher payment rates of up to 90 percent for precision agriculture conservation practices, and explicit support for precision technology acquisition.
Eligible for USDA loans to invest in rural areas specifically for expanding precision agriculture practices and financing technology.
Receive increased emphasis from the USDA to provide technical assistance for soil health, cover crops, and precision agriculture planning.

key_provisions: Defines precision agriculture and precision agriculture technology (such as GPS mapping, soil sensors, yield monitors, and variable rate technology) within the Food Security Act of 1985.
Expands the Conservation Loan and Loan Guarantee Program to cover precision agriculture practices and technologies, and prioritizes producers using loans for these purposes.
Allows rural development loans to be used by for-profit and nonprofit organizations to expand precision agriculture adoption and financing.

Permits the Secretary of Agriculture to increase payments to up to 90 percent of the costs associated with adopting precision agriculture practices and acquiring technologies for conservation implementations.

Incorporates precision agriculture conservation activities into the Conservation Stewardship Program and updates the Environmental Quality Incentives Program to include precision agriculture planning and incentive contracts.
Requires the Secretary to emphasize the use of third-party providers when delivering technical assistance for soil health planning, including cover crops and precision agriculture.

summary_detail.plain_summary: The PRECISE Act amends various USDA agricultural programs to support the adoption of precision agriculture practices and technologies. It defines precision agriculture in federal law, updates loan and conservation programs to include precision farming activities, offers increased payment rates for certain conservation practices related to precision agriculture, and emphasizes third-party technical assistance for soil health planning.
summary_detail.significance: The bill provides targeted statutory support, financial incentives, and loan opportunities for farmers and rural entities to integrate advanced technology into crop and livestock production, aiming to improve input efficiencies, minimize waste, and maintain environmental quality.
